name: Fintech
summary: Secure software for banking, payments, and finance.
description: Fintech UI UX design for banking, payments and trading products: onboarding and KYC flows, dashboards and design systems that build trust and pass compliance.
image_alt: Contactless card payment at a payment terminal, fintech industry
overview:
Money products live or die on trust. People hand over their identity, their savings and their time, and every unclear screen makes them hesitate. My job is to remove that hesitation: clear onboarding, honest numbers, and flows that explain what is happening with the user’s money at every step.

I work with founders and product teams on web and mobile fintech products, from the first prototype to a design system that engineers can build from directly. Compliance, KYC and security are part of the design from day one, not something bolted on before launch.

challenges.title: Onboarding drop-off
challenges.text: Long KYC steps and unclear document requests make new users leave before their first deposit.

challenges.title: Trust and clarity
challenges.text: Fees, balances and transaction states have to be obvious, or users assume the worst.

challenges.title: Dense data
challenges.text: Traders and finance teams need a lot of numbers on screen without the interface feeling cluttered.

challenges.title: Compliance without friction
challenges.text: Regulatory steps, consent and disclosures have to fit the flow instead of interrupting it.

faqs.question: Do you have experience designing fintech products?
faqs.answer: Yes. I have designed trading, digital wallet and payment products for web and mobile. You can see examples in the case studies on this page.

faqs.question: How do you handle KYC and compliance in the design?
faqs.answer: I map the required checks with your team early, then design them into the onboarding flow with clear explanations, progress and save-and-return, so they feel like part of the product rather than a barrier.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing design system?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can extend and clean up an existing system, or create one from scratch with tokens and components that match your codebase.

faqs.question: Do you design for both web and mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most fintech products need both, so I design responsive web apps and native-feeling iOS and Android screens that share one system.

faqs.question: How do we start?
faqs.answer: Send me a short brief through the contact page. We will have a call about your product, users and timeline, and I will come back with a plan and quote.

approach.title: Discover
